name: Gossip & Potions: Tales from the Witch Shop
source:
In Gossip and Potions, you run a potion shop in Greenhaven. Customers show up with their gossip; sorry, very serious problems, and you decide what to brew in the cauldron.

You can help them. You can make their lives harder. Sometimes you try the first and end up doing the second.

Greenhaven needs a witch. You need to pay rent. Capricornio, a one-eyed mana who has an opinion about everything, drops hints about recipes, and is still learning to talk, comes along for the ride.

Mix ingredients. Hand over whatever comes out and face the consequences of your actions.

[From [url=https://pequesoft.net/games/gossip-and-potions/]Steam[/url]]
